channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Steadies above 100.50, with bullish bias intact above key support
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 100.75 in the early European trading hours on Monday.

item.title: Equities: AI and geopolitics pressure global stocks – Deutsche Bank
item.description: Deutsche Bank strategists highlight that rising Oil and gas prices, escalating US–Iran tensions and renewed doubts over the AI (Artificial intelligence) trade weighed on global equities.

item.title: Euro trims gains as the Pound strengthens ahead of Andy Burnham’s nomination
item.description: The Euro (EUR) ticks lower against the British Pound (GBP) on Monday, trading at 0.8495 at the time of writing, as last week’s rebound from 13-month lows at 0.8455 failed to consolidate above 0.8500.

item.title: Oil: Disruptions lift prices and speculative longs – ING
item.description: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Brent Oil has broken above US$90 as escalating conflict in the Persian Gulf and potential chokepoint closures disrupt vessel flows.

item.title: British Pound: Political stability supports Sterling for now – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Thu Lan Nguyen notes that the Pound initially strengthened as markets welcomed Andy Burnham’s rapid move into 10 Downing Street and hopes for reduced political turmoil.

item.title: Euro: Upside bias holds above key support against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang sees EUR/USD consolidating with a slight downside bias intraday, expecting moves within 1.1405–1.1450. Over 1–3 weeks, the Euro is still viewed with an upside bias as long as 1.1405 holds, though momentum toward 1.1520 remains uncertain.

item.title: British Pound steadily climbs to 1.3465 on softer USD as UK Awaits new PM
item.description: The GBP/USD pair rebounds around 30 pips from the Asian session low on Monday, snapping a two-day losing streak amid a modest US Dollar (USD) downtick.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar edges higher above 0.5850 as softer US inflation dampens Fed rate hike bets
item.description: The NZD/USD pair holds positive ground near 0.5855 during the early European session on Monday. The US Dollar (USD) weakens against the New Zealand Dollar (NZD) as softer US inflation data have led traders to cut bets on imminent rate hikes from the US Federal Reserve (Fed).

item.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Tests 1.4000 after breaking below 50-day EMA
item.description: USD/CAD extends its losses for the second successive day. trading around 1.4010 during the Asian hours on Monday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is moving downward within the descending channel, suggesting an ongoing bearish bias.

item.title: Japanese Yen underperforms as Middle East conflicts intensify
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades lower against its major currency peers, but is marginally higher against the US Dollar (USD) at around 162.35 during the early European trading session on Monday.

item.title: Indian Rupee starts weak negatively as oil prices extend gains
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens on a weak note against the US Dollar (USD) at the start of the week. The USD/INR pair jumps to near 96.46 as a fresh surge in oil prices and the consistent outflow of foreign funds from the Indian stock market are hurting the Indian currency.

item.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Edges higher to near 1.1450 but remains capped below 100-day SMA
item.description: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.1445 during the early European trading hours on Monday, bolstered by a hawkish tone from the European Central Bank (ECB).

item.title: Indonesian Rupiah declines as fuel shortages amplify concerns over fiscal strain
item.description: USD/IDR halts its four-day losing streak, trading around 18,020 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces headwinds from rising crude oil prices.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Bulls retain control near one-month high, around $83.50 on Iran risks
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – kicks off the new week on a positive note and touches a fresh high since June 12, around the $84.40-$84.45 region, during the Asian session.

item.title: Australian Dollar gains ground against Japanese Yen, intervention risk looms
item.description: The AUD/JPY cross gains ground to near 113.55 during the early European session on Monday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) edges higher against the Japanese Yen (JPY) due to the interest rate differential between the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ).

item.title: Gold extends fragile recovery from monthly low on soft USD; upside seems limited
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) reverses a modest Asian session dip to the $3,983-$3,982 area and is now looking to build on Friday's bounce from the monthly low. The intraday uptick is sponsored by a softer US Dollar (USD), which tends to benefit the commodity.

item.title: EUR/JPY Price Forecast: Holds above nine-day EMA support at 185.50
item.description: EUR/JPY remains subdued for the third consecutive day, trading around 185.80 during the Asian hours on Monday. The currency cross is holding a constructive bullish bias as it stays above both the nine-day and 50-day Exponential Moving Averages (EMAs), now aligned as nearby dynamic support.

item.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Recovers to near 0.7000 amid US Dollar’s weakness
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades 0.12% higher to near 0.6995 against the US Dollar (USD) during the Asian trading session on Monday.

item.title: Swiss Franc gains ground ahead of Trade Balance data
item.description: USD/CHF extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 0.8070 during the Asian hours on Monday. The pair depreciates as the Swiss Franc (CHF) receives support ahead of the release of Trade Balance data for June.

item.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD rises toward $57.00 despite Fed hike bets
item.description: Silver price (XAG/USD) gains ground for the second successive day, trading around $56.80 per troy ounce during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: United States Dollar Index struggles to lure buyers despite Iran tensions, Fed hike bets
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, struggles to capitalize on a modest Asian session uptick on Monday and currently trades around the 100.80-100.75 region, nearly unchanged for the day.

item.title: Canadian Dollar edges higher to near 1.4000 as crude oil gains
item.description: The USD/CAD pair extends its downside to near 1.4005 during the Asian trading hours on Monday. Rising crude oil prices provide some support to the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD).

item.title: Japanese Yen hangs near four-decade low as bears turn cautious amid intervention risks
item.description: The USD/JPY pair seesaws between tepid gains/minor losses during the Asian session on Monday and currently trades just below mid-162.00s amid relatively thin liquidity on the back of a holiday in Japan.

item.title: US President Donald Trump says US hitting Iran 'very hard’
item.description: US President Donald Trump said that the latest US strikes on Iran were being carried out in honour of US service members killed in recent days, the Guardian reported on Monday.

item.title: New Zealand Dollar remains subdued following PBoC policy decision
item.description: NZD/USD remains in negative territory for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.5840 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: British Pound holds steady near 1.3450 as US-Iran strikes intensify
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades on a flat note around 1.3450 during the early Asian session on Monday. Traders continue to assess the developments surrounding US-Iran tensions after the US said that a third American troop was killed in the past two days.

item.title: PBOC sets USD/CNY reference rate at 6.7948 vs. 6.7934 previous
item.description: On Monday, the People’s Bank of China (PBOC) sets the USD/CNY central rate for the trading session ahead at 6.7948 compared to Friday's fix of 6.7934 and 6.7577 Reuters estimate.

item.title: PBOC holds Loan Prime Rates steady in July
item.description: The People’s Bank of China (PBOC), China's central bank, announced to leave its Loan Prime Rates (LPRs) unchanged on Monday. The one-year and five-year LPRs were at 3.00% and 3.50%, respectively.

item.title: Euro bulls remain on the sidelines as USD gains on US-Iran tensions and inflation fears
item.description: The EUR/USD pair kicks off the new week on a softer note, though it lacks follow-through selling, warranting caution before positioning for an extension of the pullback from a nearly four-week high touched last Wednesday.

item.title: WTI surges above $83.00 amid escalating US-Iran conflict
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price opened at a bullish gap, trading around $83.50 per barrel during the Asian hours on Monday.
